question: What is the URA Research Lab and how do academic researchers access anonymized tax microdata?
answer: The URA Research Lab is a secure repository of clean, anonymized tax microdata established under the Research and Innovation Division within the Commissioner General's office. The lab's primary mission is to foster collaborative, evidence-based research for informing national tax policy, macroeconomic modeling, and administrative modernization. Governed by the Research Lab Management Committee (headed by the Assistant Commissioner Research & Innovation), access is open to accredited researchers, academic scholars, and institutional policy analysts who submit formal research proposals and sign strict non-disclosure data protection agreements under URA's data governance framework.

question: Where can I find official URA Revenue Performance Reports and Corporate Strategic Plans?
answer: Official reports and strategic planning documents are published under Research & Publications on the URA portal: 1) Revenue Performance Reports: Annual and semi-annual revenue collection reports (FY 2022-23 2.95 MB, FY 2021-22 1.82 MB, FY 2020-21) detailing gross revenue collections, GDP tax ratios, net surplus/deficits, and tax head contributions (downloadable at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/revenue-performance-reports/); 2) Corporate Plans: URA Strategic Plan FY 2025/26 – 2029/30 (7 MB PDF), Client Satisfaction Survey Report 2024 (7 MB PDF), and historic corporate plans (downloadable at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/corporate-plans/); 3) Research Bulletins & Trade Reports: Regular macroeconomic bulletins, import/export statistics, and trade analysis at https://ura.go.ug/en/research-publications/.

question: What research topics and innovation projects are supported by URA?
answer: URA Research and Innovation Division conducts and sponsors research across tax compliance behavior, digital taxation, informal sector formalization, property tax efficiency, customs fraud detection, and trade facilitation. It also tracks strategic organizational innovations (electronic single window, EFRIS, DTS, BWIMS, and AI tax tools) published under URA Projects at https://ura.go.ug/download-category/ura-projects/.
